findings.title: Service Bound to All Interfaces (0.0.0.0:8085)
findings.details: Port 8085 (python3 (PID 1100)) accepts connections from all local network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of binding to loopback (127.0.0.1) or routing through Cloudflare Zero Trust.
findings.remediation: Bind service to 127.0.0.1 and tunnel externally via Cloudflare Tunnel.
